name: .sharkconfig Discovery Performance
description: Discovery walks up directory trees efficiently, caching results per path to avoid re-scanning

cachingMechanism.projectPathCache: Maps file path → project root (or null)

criteria.passCondition: Discovery walks up from file's directory, finds .sharkconfig in deep path, second call is instant (cache hit)
criteria.failCondition: Discovery walks the entire tree on every tool call with no caching
